verdict.rationale: SES API v2 explicitly supports a 'Templated' message type with personalization tags that are replaced with supplied values, showing template-based sending exists, but the evidence pack never documents CreateTemplate/UpdateTemplate/versioning APIs or sending strictly by template id, and community feedback notes users must build templating features themselves rather than rely on rich native tooling. missing for 10: explicit CreateTemplate/UpdateTemplate/versioning API documentation, confirmation of sending by template id with variable payloads, independent hands-on confirmation of template management workflow.
